name: Omakeylog
author: cesarfilho
description: Measures how often you press each key and each adjacent key-pair, to help you design a better QMK keymap (home-row placement, thumb/layer keys, less finger travel). It records aggregate counts only - never the text you type - and shows ranked keys, hand and finger load, same-finger bigrams and QMK suggestions in a panel. A bundled evdev engine does the counting; the bar widget starts and stops it.

barWidget.description: Key-frequency analyzer for QMK layout tuning: records per-key and bigram counts (no text), shows ranked keys, hand/finger load, same-finger bigrams and layout suggestions.
